source: src/data/characters.js (ROSTER, including military; migrated power-ups included)
ranking: Descending declared base speed / strength. Competition ties: 1, 1, 3. Missing values are unranked. Speed excludes flight gears, buffs, dash, teleport and runtime modifiers. Strength is not overall combat power; no DPS-based overall ranking.

audit.hoverboard: No canonical roster definition declares a hoverboard. Infantry research documents mention hoverboards; those references are not playable roster records.
audit.deck52: Deck 52 is documented as a planned hireable mercenary subfaction in docs/FACTIONS_AND_PRESENTATION_DIRECTION_2026-09-13.md. It is not in canonical ROSTER; unfinished models, gun standards and behavior packages are explicitly deferred.
